retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, minimalist composition featuring a male figure in formal wear interacting with a disco ball against a stark white background.
triggerTerms: man in suit stepping on disco ball
high-key fashion photography with serif typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, high-key studio photograph of a man in a black tuxedo and white shirt, captured in a dynamic motion of stepping onto a mirrored disco ball. The composition is anchored by a horizontal line of bold, modern serif typography that overlaps the subject's leg.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned on the right third, creating asymmetrical balance
Horizontal text line bisecting the verticality of the subject
High-contrast black attire against a near-white neutral background
Interaction between the organic human form and the geometric disco ball
coreInvariants: Stark white or off-white studio background
Black formal tuxedo with white dress shirt
Mirrored disco ball as the primary prop

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is full-body, positioned on the right side of the frame, scaled to occupy roughly 60% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The disco ball at the bottom right serves as the weight-bearing anchor for the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the subject's face, follows the line of the body down to the disco ball, then moves left along the horizontal text line.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space on the left half of the frame provides breathing room for typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low saturation environment with deep black shadows on the subject for definition.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to one warm accent tone

letterConstructionRules: Extreme contrast between thick and thin strokes
Ball terminals on specific characters like 'J' and 'R'
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight kerning to create a solid horizontal block
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family with color-blocking to distinguish words.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast fashion aesthetic and sharp serifs.
Provides the necessary weight and vertical stress.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key studio photo of a man in a black tuxedo stepping on a mirrored disco ball against a white wall. Ensure the left side has ample negative space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase bold Didone serif text horizontally across the middle, using black for the first word and copper for the second, ensuring it slightly overlaps the subject's leg.

verificationChecks: Does the text overlap the subject?
Is the disco ball reflecting the studio light?
Is the typography a high-contrast serif?

adjustableVariables: Specific prop (e.g., replacing disco ball with another geometric object)
mustRedesign: Do not replicate exact brand logos
postGenerationChecks: Check for clean separation between subject and background
Ensure text legibility over the subject's clothing
Verify the disco ball has realistic mirror reflections
Confirm the color split in the text is distinct
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key studio photography + [Subject in Formal Wear] + [Geometric Prop] + [Overlapping Bold Serif Typography]
